original_benchmark.notes: Public split of the 88-task benchmark (HF RSI-Exam/RSI-Exam @ 66f54935). Upstream is authored natively in Harbor task format and evaluated with Harbor plus the autoresearch prompt/mount overlay. Upstream does not pin agent versions.
Held back by the RSI-Exam authors (contact@rsi-exam.ai). If provided locally, the adapter can convert it via --source-dir.

harbor_adapter.notes: Tasks copied verbatim; only [task].name is rewritten to rsi-exam/<task_id>. 25 tasks receive a baseline (no-op) solve.sh (24 without an upstream oracle, plus qec_decoder_arena whose upstream oracle cannot run); mbff_banking_placement's upstream oracle gets a prebuild fix. Oracle verified on both sides on the 22 CPU-only tasks: 21/22 identical rewards. Parity pending coordination with the Harbor team (12h/task agent budget; 9 tasks need accelerators (8 NVIDIA GPU, 1 TPU v6e), 4 need task-side LLM API keys).
